implementation.change: Executable closure identity calculation consumes the SemanticIdentities map already produced by the current frontend result. If that map is unavailable, the caller omits the closure identity and conservatively loses closure-based artifact reuse.
implementation.scope: Avoids a second semantic-identity traversal within one frontend invocation. The frontend still verifies the full source snapshot; this does not reuse verified Language facts across source snapshots.

identity_map_stress.note: Synthetic closure stress measurement in one release test process. It measures the avoided identity-map traversal plus closure fingerprinting versus closure fingerprinting with the already-produced map; it is not an end-to-end application build benchmark.
